en.headline: City Chamber Orchestra premieres Space Fantasy in Tsuen Wan this weekend
en.dek: Three English-language family performances run on Saturday and Sunday at Tsuen Wan Town Hall Auditorium, with tickets from HK$120 at URBTIX.
body: The City Chamber Orchestra of Hong Kong presents the premiere of Space Fantasy at Tsuen Wan Town Hall Auditorium this weekend. Performances are scheduled for 3 p.m. and 7.30 p.m. on Saturday, 29 August, and 3 p.m. on Sunday, 30 August.

The production was created, produced and directed by Leanne Nicholls, with music by Luna Pan and Miles Brown. The orchestra said the English-language show, listed as suitable for ages three and above, follows an alien character who encounters NASA’s Voyager Golden Record, mixing live orchestral and electronic music with theatre, dance, digital art and circus acts.

Tickets are priced at HK$600, HK$400, HK$250 and HK$120 through URBTIX. The organisers said a 50 per cent concession applies to full-time students, people aged 60 or above, Comprehensive Social Security Assistance recipients, and people with disabilities plus one accompanying minder. The venue is a short walk from Tsuen Wan MTR Exit A1 or Tsuen Wan West Exit A2.

zh.headline: 城市室樂團《太空幻遊》本周末荃灣大會堂首演
zh.dek: 周六下午3時及晚上7時半、周日下午3時於荃灣大會堂演奏廳演出，英語家庭節目，門票120至600元於城市售票網發售。
body: 香港城市室樂團本周末於荃灣大會堂演奏廳首演《太空幻遊》。演出時間為8月29日（周六）下午3時及晚上7時30分，以及8月30日（周日）下午3時。
製作由黎燕欣創作、製作及執導，音樂由潘玥及Miles Brown創作。主辦單位表示，節目以英語演出，建議3歲或以上觀眾入場，講述外星角色接觸美國航天總署旅行者金唱片的故事，結合現場管弦樂、電子音樂、劇場、舞蹈、數碼影像及雜技。
門票分600元、400元、250元及120元，於城市售票網發售。主辦單位指全日制學生、60歲或以上人士、綜援受助人，以及殘疾人士及其一名陪同者可享五折。場地可由港鐵荃灣站A1出口或荃灣西站A2出口步行前往。
